scope: Latest final-corrected scope: Pester-only new Progress suite (48 cases) plus unchanged Native (23) and NativeInput (6), 77 passed per shell on mainA29E6. Prior76 green main286A and75 green main9C803 scopes are preserved as historical snapshots. No static, Full, real-media, interactive desktop, or real console gesture claims are made by this ledger.
coverage: monotonic bounded finite stage ranges and indeterminate unknown/nonfinite duration
separate structured stdout and complete stderr under fragmentation, invalid/truncated/oversized records, floods and native nonzero exit
active Request()/C#-timer cancellation at analysis/render/verification with an independent benign native survivor
pre-cancel no native start, ordinary-app borrowed-context inspection130 before native invocation, unread caller-owned input cancellation, ordinary held-input transfer failure
failing progress display sink isolation and no helper/native100 before application validation/publication
limitations: Generic stage-state and native-wrapper tests do not establish application stage ordering; root real-media/integration evidence supplies that proof.
Injected unavailable Write-Progress sink is separate from redirected process output and actual console CTRL_C/CTRL_BREAK. Those are separate root/agent scopes.
These tests assert bounded owned-child termination and preserve the caller-held stream; they do not claim process-name-wide termination or an interactive desktop console-close gesture.
corrections: Pester lifecycle hooks moved into a Describe; initial rejection retained.

Capture now extracts the Pester.Run PassThru object from merged records; an intermediate same-file multi-stream redirection attempt aborted before Pester, both hosts exit1, with zero-byte logs and no counts claimed.
Oversized test stdout now comes from a test-owned UTF-8 file instead of a Windows environment value.
Dedicated native fixture treats empty optional values as defaults consistently in PS5.1/7; giant diagnostic assertions are boolean/bounded.
Read-only review found overflowing field-count blocks poisoned later progress. Root corrected bounded terminator reset, and the new regression requires later valid2s/3s blocks to recover.
Requested cancellation pipe IO faults have an additive cancellation input diagnostic; ordinary input failures remain errors.
Root narrowed the cancellation input diagnostic to the actually caught copy-task base-exception reference so unrelated caught errors remain visible.
Root inspection version/filter/probe/pan catches now honour an already requested context; the added ordinary-app regression exercises the version-inspection boundary.

Final staged whitespace audit caught trailing spaces in selected public Pester summary lines. Normalize those derivative lines only, preserve prior public digests per run and original raw hashes; no test or runtime recapture is implied.

harnesses.source:
param([string]$Repository, [string]$Scope, [string]$ShellLabel)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$paths = @('WinAudioClean.ps1','WinAudioClean.IO.ps1','tests/WinAudioClean.Progress.Tests.ps1','tests/WinAudioClean.Native.Tests.ps1','tests/WinAudioClean.NativeInput.Tests.ps1','tests/fixtures/ProgressProcessFixture.cs','tests/fixtures/New-ProgressProcessFixture.ps1','tests/fixtures/ProgressProcessFixture.md','tests/fixtures/NativeProcessFixture.cs','tests/fixtures/New-NativeProcessFixture.ps1')
$before = @(foreach ($path in $paths) { [ordered]@{path=$path;sha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Repository $path) -Algorithm SHA256).Hash} })
$directory = Join-Path $Repository '.wac-local/WAC-M3-04/progress-focused'
$log = Join-Path $directory ($Scope+'-'+$ShellLabel+'.log')
$metadata = Join-Path $directory ($Scope+'-'+$ShellLabel+'.json')
Import-Module (Join-Path $Repository '.wac-local/Modules/Pester/5.7.1/Pester.psd1') -Force
$testPaths = @('tests/WinAudioClean.Progress.Tests.ps1','tests/WinAudioClean.Native.Tests.ps1','tests/WinAudioClean.NativeInput.Tests.ps1') | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $Repository $_ }
$started = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
$result = Invoke-Pester -Path $testPaths -Output Detailed -PassThru *> $log
$code = 0
if ($result.PassedCount -eq 0 -or $result.FailedCount -gt 0 -or $result.FailedContainersCount -gt 0 -or $result.FailedBlocksCount -gt 0) { $code = 1 }
$after = @(foreach ($path in $before) { $hash=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Repository $path.path) -Algorithm SHA256).Hash; [ordered]@{path=$path.path;sha256=$hash;unchanged=($hash -eq $path.sha256)} })
$record = [ordered]@{scope='Pester-only Progress + existing Native + NativeInput';shell=$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString();pester=(Get-Module Pester).Version.ToString();startedUtc=$started;finishedUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o');passed=$result.PassedCount;failed=$result.FailedCount;skipped=$result.SkippedCount;notRun=$result.NotRunCount;total=$result.TotalCount;failedContainers=$result.FailedContainersCount;failedBlocks=$result.FailedBlocksCount;exitCode=$code;sourceUnchanged=(@($after|Where-Object {-not $_.unchanged}).Count -eq 0);sourcesBefore=$before;sourcesAfter=$after;rawLogSha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $log -Algorithm SHA256).Hash;command=@((Get-Process -Id $PID).Path,'-NoLogo','-NoProfile','-NonInteractive','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',(Join-Path $directory 'Invoke-Focused.ps1'),'-Repository',$Repository,'-Scope',$Scope,'-ShellLabel',$ShellLabel);failures=@($result.Tests|Where-Object {$_.Result -eq 'Failed'}|ForEach-Object {[ordered]@{name=$_.ExpandedName;message=($_.ErrorRecord.Exception.Message -join '; ')}})}
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($metadata,($record|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12)+[Environment]::NewLine,[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
$record | Select-Object scope,shell,passed,failed,skipped,notRun,total,exitCode,sourceUnchanged | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
exit $code
